about_the_game:
Tired of co-op games where your friends are just... there? In Valor Hunters, your teammates are your greatest weapon. Literally.

  • 1-4 Player Online Co-Op: Lead a chaotic uprising against a tyrannical corporation with friends, or brave the fight as a solo hero.

  • Throw Your Friends Into Battle: The heart of Valor Hunters—use your teammates as weapons and tools in a game-changing, physics-based combat system.

  • Intense Roguelite Bullet-Hell: Face down hordes of enemies in frantic, top-down combat where no two missions are ever the same.

  • Bite-Sized, Replayable Missions: Jump into explosive 15-20 minute runs designed for "just one more go" sessions with endless replayability.

  • Devastating Ability Combos: Merge your powers with your teammates' to create spectacular, screen-clearing synergies.

  • Skill-Based Progression: Forget the grind. Success comes from strategic choices and mastery, unlocking new tactical options, not just bigger stats.

  • A Whimsical Sci-Fi Rebellion: Liberate a vibrant galaxy full of character, absurdity, and story-worthy moments of glorious chaos.

Join the Uprising on Discord!

Valor Hunters is a community-first game, built hand-in-hand with players like you. Our Discord server is the heart of the rebellion where you can give feedback directly to the devs, take part in monthly challenges, and win exclusive giveaways. We're also looking for passionate players to become our official Community Champions! Your voice matters—join the Discord today and help us build the future of co-op chaos.

It’s Time to Team Up. For Real.

Welcome to the rebellion, Hunter. In the whimsical but ruthlessly-ruled galaxy of Valor Hunters, cooperation isn't just encouraged—it's a full-contact sport.

A New Class of Co-Op Chaos

Teamwork in Valor Hunters is physical, dynamic, and frequently hilarious. Our entire gameplay system is built to reward true cooperation in ways you've never seen before. Combine your unique Hunter abilities for devastating results, use the environment to your advantage, and remember that sometimes the best tool for the job is your friend.

The Perfect Run, Every Time

Dive into missions that are the perfect length for a single thrilling session, but with a rogue-lite core that will keep you coming back for hundreds of hours. With procedurally generated maps, objectives, and a vast pool of game-changing augments to find during each run, your tactical approach will need to evolve constantly. The perfect build is out there—you just have to survive long enough to create it.

Master the Strategy, Not the Grind

Progression is about unlocking new ways to play. Expand your roster of playable Hunters, each with their own unique abilities and playstyles. Discover new weapons and tactical gear that open up different strategic possibilities. Your power comes from your skill and creativity in combining these elements, not from endless grinding for a +1% damage boost.

The uprising needs heroes. It needs you. And it definitely needs you to be able to throw your friends.

WISHLIST VALOR HUNTERS NOW AND JOIN THE UPRISING!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mojave 10.14+
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1+) or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal capable Intel and AMD GPUs
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Mojave 10.14+
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1+) or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 or newer
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Valor Hunters is a chaotic online Co-Op roguelite where the teamwork gets absurd. Throw your friends into the fight and combine your powers to take down a tyrannical corporation in this whimsical Sci-Fi world. Every mission is story-worthy bullet-hell built for 4-player Co-Op or solo.
